shared_elements: low-relief carving on a vertical face
justification: Both are upright slabs bearing low-relief carving on their broad vertical faces, but what is depicted differs entirely: A shows dense vertical columns of blocky, repeated composite sign-units filling the whole surface, while B shows a single large quadruped-like animal in profile, isolated in the upper zone with the rest of the face left blank. The carving conventions also diverge, A being tightly ordered, compartmentalised and ornate, B being sparse, outline-based and pictorial.
